paragraphs: The following describes the business of Fidelity National Financial, Inc. and its subsidiaries. Except where otherwise noted, all references to "we," "us," "our", the "Company" or "FNF" are to Fidelity National Financial, Inc. and its subsidiaries, taken together.

We are a leading provider of (i) title insurance, escrow and other title-related services, including trust activities, trustee sales guarantees, recordings and reconveyances and home warranty and (ii) transaction services to the real estate and mortgage industries. FNF is one of the nation's largest title insurance companies operating through its title insurance underwriters - Fidelity National Title Insurance Company ("FNTIC"), Chicago Title Insurance Company ("Chicago Title"), Commonwealth Land Title Insurance Company ("Commonwealth Land Title"), Alamo Title Insurance ("Alamo Title") and National Title Insurance of New York Inc. ("National Title of New York") - which collectively issue more title insurance policies than any other title company in the United States. Through our subsidiary ServiceLink Holdings, LLC ("ServiceLink"), we provide mortgage transaction services including title-related services and facilitation of production and management of mortgage loans. We are also a leading provider of insurance solutions serving retail annuity and life customers and institutional clients through our majority-owned subsidiary, F&G Annuities & Life, Inc. ("F&G").

On December 1, 2022, we completed our previously announced separation and distribution to our shareholders, on a pro rata basis, of approximately 15% of the common stock of F&G (the "F&G Distribution"). Following the F&G Distribution, we retained control of F&G through an approximate 85% ownership stake. The F&G Distribution was accomplished by the distribution of 68 shares of common stock, par value $0.001 per share, of F&G for every 1,000 shares of our common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, as a dividend to each holder of shares of our common stock as of the close of business on November 22, 2022, the record date for the F&G Distribution. On December 31, 2025, we completed our previously announced distribution to our shareholders, on a pro rata basis, of approximately 12% of the common stock of F&G (the "2025 F&G Distribution"). As a result of the 2025 F&G Distribution, we own approximately 70% of the common stock of F&G.

As a result of the F&G Distribution, F&G is a separate, publicly traded company and its businesses, assets and liabilities consist of those related to F&G's business as a provider of insurance solutions serving retail annuity and life customers and institutional clients. Through F&G's insurance subsidiaries, including Fidelity & Guaranty Life Insurance Company ("FGL Insurance") and Fidelity & Guaranty Life Insurance Company of New York ("FGL NY Insurance"), F&G markets a broad portfolio of deferred annuities, including fixed indexed annuities ("FIA"), registered index-linked annuities ("RILA"), (together referred to as indexed annuities) and fixed rate annuities including multi-year guarantee annuities ("MYGAs"), immediate annuities, indexed universal life insurance ("IUL"), funding agreements (through funding agreement-backed notes issuances ("FABNs") and the Federal Home Loan Bank of Atlanta ("FHLB")) and pension risk transfer solutions ("PRTs"). All of FNF's core title insurance, real estate, technology and mortgage related businesses, assets and liabilities that are not held by F&G remain with FNF.
As of December 31, 2025, we had the following reporting segments:

•Title. This segment consists of the operations of our title insurance underwriters and related businesses, which provide title insurance and escrow and other title-related services including trust activities, trustee sales guarantees, and home warranty products. This segment also includes our transaction services business, which includes other title-related services used in the production and management of mortgage loans, including mortgage loans that experience default.

•F&G. This segment primarily consists of operations of our annuities and life insurance related businesses. This segment issues a broad portfolio of annuity and life insurance products, including deferred annuities, immediate annuities, and IUL insurance, through its retail distribution channels. This segment also provides funding agreements and PRTs through its institutional channels.

•Corporate and Other. This segment consists of the operations of the parent holding company, our real estate technology subsidiaries, other smaller, non-title businesses and certain unallocated corporate overhead expenses and eliminations of revenues and expenses between it and our Title segment.
We believe that our competitive strengths include the following:
Corporate principles. A cornerstone of our management philosophy and operating success is the six fundamental precepts upon which we were founded, which are:
•Autonomy and entrepreneurship; •Bias for action; •Customer-oriented and motivated; •Minimize bureaucracy;
These six precepts are emphasized to our employees from the first day of employment and are integral to many of our strategies described below.

Leading residential and commercial title insurance company. We are one of the largest title insurance companies in the United States and a leading provider of title insurance and escrow and other title-related services for real estate transactions. Through the third quarter of 2025, our insurance companies had a 32% share of the U.S. title insurance market, according to the American Land Title Association ("ALTA"). While residential title insurance comprises the majority of our business, we are also a significant provider of commercial real estate title insurance in the United States. Our network of independent title agents and employees in our direct operations that service the commercial real estate markets is one of the largest in the industry. Our commercial network combined with our financial strength makes our title insurance operations attractive to large national lenders that require the underwriting and issuing of larger commercial title policies.

Established relationships with our customers. We have strong relationships with the customers who use our title services. Our distribution network, which includes approximately 1,300 direct title offices and approximately 5,100 agents, is among the largest in the United States. We also benefit from strong brand recognition in our multiple title brands that allows us to access a broader client base than if we operated under a single consolidated brand and provides our customers with a choice among brands.

headings: Risk Factors Relating to Market Conditions
If economic and credit market conditions deteriorate, it could have a material adverse impact on our investment portfolio and could also cause our stock price to fluctuate significantly.
Equity market volatility could negatively impact our business.
Conditions in the economy generally could adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.
Our investments are subject to market and credit risks. These risks could be heightened during periods of extreme volatility or disruption in financial and credit markets.
If adverse changes in the levels of real estate activity occur, our revenues may decline.
Interest rate fluctuations could adversely affect our business, financial condition, liquidity, results of operations and cash flows.
F&G is exposed to liquidity risk as a result of its other risks.
Risk Factors Relating to Our Business
We have recorded goodwill as a result of prior acquisitions, and an economic downturn could cause these balances to become impaired, requiring write-downs that would reduce our operating income.
We may face losses if our actual experience differs significantly from our reserve assumptions.
We are a holding company and depend on distributions from our subsidiaries for cash.
Our business could be interrupted or compromised if we experience difficulties arising from outsourcing relationships.
If we are unable to attract and retain national marketing organizations and independent agents, sales of our products may be reduced.

Failure of our enterprise-wide risk management processes could result in unexpected monetary losses, damage to our reputation, additional costs or impairment of our ability to conduct business effectively.
Changes in the Company's dealings with large mortgage lenders, servicers or government-sponsored enterprises could adversely affect our title insurance and mortgage servicing subsidiaries.
If the rating agencies downgrade our insurance companies, our results of operations and financial condition may suffer.
If our claim loss prevention procedures fail, we could incur significant claim losses.
Our use of independent agents for a significant amount of our title insurance policies could adversely impact the frequency and severity of title claims.
Our business is subject to risk due to our owned distribution strategy and investments in distribution consolidation.
Risk Factors Related to our Majority Ownership in F&G
The F&G Distribution could adversely affect our results of operations or financial condition.
Certain F&G directors may have actual or potential conflicts of interest because of their FNF equity ownership or their current or former FNF positions.
Risk Factors Relating to the Geographic Concentrations of our Business Segments

Concentration in certain states for the distribution of our life insurance and annuity products in our F&G segment may subject us to losses attributable to economic downturns or catastrophes in those states.
Risk Factors Relating to Government Regulation of the Insurance Industry
State regulation of the rates we charge for title insurance could adversely affect our results of operations.
Our F&G segment is highly regulated and subject to numerous legal restrictions and regulations.

F&G's business is subject to government regulation in each of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business and regulators have broad administrative and discretionary authority over our business and business practices.
paragraphs: In addition to the normal risks of business, we are subject to significant risks and uncertainties, including those listed below and others described elsewhere in this Annual Report. Any of the risks described herein could result in a significant or material adverse effect on our results of operations or financial condition.

Our investment portfolio is exposed to economic and financial market risks, including changes in interest rates, credit markets and prices of marketable equity and fixed-income securities. Our investment policy in our title business is designed to maximize total return through investment income and capital appreciation consistent with moderate risk of principal, while providing adequate liquidity and complying with internal and regulatory guidelines. To achieve this objective, our marketable debt investments are primarily investment grade, liquid, fixed-income securities and money market instruments denominated in U.S. dollars. We make investments in certain equity securities and preferred stock in order to take advantage of perceived value and for strategic purposes. Economic and credit market conditions may adversely affect the ability of some issuers of investment securities to repay their obligations and affect the values of investment securities. If the carrying value of our investments exceeds the fair value, and the decline in fair value is deemed to be other-than-temporary, we will be required to write down the value of our investments, which could have a material negative impact on our results of operations and financial condition.

Fixed maturities, equity securities and derivatives represent the majority of total cash and invested assets reported at fair value on our balance sheets. Fair value is defined as the price that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date (an exit price). Fair value estimates are made based on available market information and judgments about the financial instrument at a specific point in time. Expectations that our investments will continue to perform in accordance with their contractual terms are based on evidence gathered through our normal credit surveillance process and on assumptions a market participant would use in determining the current fair value.

The value and performance of certain of our assets are dependent upon the performance of collateral underlying these investments. It is possible the collateral will not meet performance expectations leading to adverse changes in the cash flows on our holdings of these types of securities.

In addition, many factors unrelated to our business could cause the market price of our common stock to rise and fall, including the operating and stock price performance of other comparable companies, investors' general perception of our industry and changes in general economic and market conditions. If the market for stocks in our industry, or the stock market in general, experiences a loss of investor confidence, the trading price of our common stock could decline for reasons unrelated to our business, financial condition or results of operations. If any of the foregoing occurs, it could cause our stock price to fall and may expose us to lawsuits that, even if successfully defended, could be costly to defend and a distraction to management.

The estimated cost of providing GMWB riders associated with our annuity products incorporates various assumptions about the overall performance of equity markets over certain time periods. Periods of significant and sustained downturns in equity markets or increased equity volatility could result in an increase in the valuation of the Market Risk Benefit ("MRB") or contractholder funds balance liabilities associated with such products, resulting in a reduction in our revenues and net income.

On June 11, 2025, the Company effected a redomestication of the Company from the State of Delaware to the State of Nevada (the "Redomestication"). As of June 11, 2025, the affairs of the Company ceased to be governed by the Delaware General Corporation Law and the Company adopted a new certificate of incorporation and bylaws governed by the Nevada Revised Statutes. The Redomestication did not result in any change in the business, physical location, management, assets, liabilities, or net worth of the Company, nor did it result in any change in location of the Company's current employees, including management. The Redomestication did not affect any of the Company's material contracts with any third parties, and the Company's rights and obligations under those material contractual arrangements will continue to be the rights and obligations of the Company after the Redomestication. The daily business operations of the Company will continue as they were conducted prior to the Redomestication. The consolidated financial condition and results of operations of the Company immediately after consummation of the Redomestication remain the same as immediately before the Redomestication.

Our Title segment revenue is closely related to the level of real estate activity that includes sales, mortgage financing and mortgage refinancing. Declines in the level of real estate activity or the average price of real estate sales will adversely affect our title insurance revenues.
We have found that residential real estate activity is generally dependent on the following factors:
•mortgage interest rates; •mortgage funding supply; •housing inventory and home prices; •supply and demand for commercial real estate; and
•the strength of the United States economy, including employment levels.

The most recent forecast of the MBA, as of February 17, 2026, estimated (actual for fiscal year 2024) the size of the U.S. residential mortgage originations market as shown in the following table for 2024 - 2028 in its "Mortgage Finance Forecast" (in trillions):
2027 2026 2025 2024 Purchase transactions 1.5 $ 1.5 $ 1.4 $ 1.4 $ 1.3 Refinance transactions 0.7 $ 0.7 $ 0.8 $ 0.7 $ 0.4
Total U.S. mortgage originations forecast 2.2 $ 2.2 $ 2.2 $ 2.1 $ 1.7

The Federal Reserve raised the benchmark interest rate from near zero as of March 2022 to a range between 5.25% and 5.50% in July 2023 in an effort to combat inflation. Following a decline in inflation in 2024, the Federal Reserve reduced the benchmark rate to a range of 4.25% and 4.50% as of December 31, 2024. The Federal Reserve further reduced the benchmark rate by 75 basis points in 2025 to a range of 3.50% and 3.75% as of December 31, 2025. Average interest rates for a 30-year fixed rate mortgage were averaged 6.6%, 6.7% and 6.8% during the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

A shortage in the supply of homes for sale, increasing home prices, varying mortgage interest rates, inflation, disrupted labor markets, and geopolitical uncertainties created a challenging residential real estate market in 2023, 2024, and 2025. In early 2026, the federal government implemented or proposed reforms to address housing and home affordability, including a directive to certain government-sponsored enterprises to purchase up to $200 billion of mortgage-backed securities in an effort to lower interest rates, enhance affordability and reduce the spread between mortgage rates and Treasury yields.

Existing-home sales increased 1% in December 2025 as compared to the corresponding month in 2024, while median existing-home sales prices rose to $405,400 in December 2025, a 0.4% increase over the corresponding month in 2024. Existing-home sales decreased 9% in December 2024 as compared to the corresponding month in 2023, while median existing-home sales prices rose to $404,400 in December 2024, a 6% increase over the corresponding month in 2023.

According to the U.S. Department of Labor's Bureau of Labor, the unemployment rate was near record lows throughout 2023. The unemployment rate was 4.4%, 4.1% and 3.7% in December of 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

paragraphs: 以下說明 Fidelity National Financial, Inc. 及其子公司之業務。除非另有說明，所有提及 "we"、"us"、"our"、"the Company" 或 "FNF" 皆指 Fidelity National Financial, Inc. 及其子公司，合計而言。

我們是提供 (i) 不動產保險、託管及其它不動產相關服務，包括信託業務、 trustee sales guarantees、登記與再轉讓及住宅保修，以及 (ii) 不動產與房貸產業交易服務之領導供應商。FNF 是美國最大的不動產保險公司之一，透過其不動產保險經理人 - Fidelity National Title Insurance Company ("FNTIC"), Chicago Title Insurance Company ("Chicago Title"), Commonwealth Land Title Insurance Company ("Commonwealth Land Title"), Alamo Title Insurance ("Alamo Title") 以及 National Title Insurance of New York Inc. ("National Title of New York") - 這些公司合計發行的不動產保險保單數量，超過美國任何其他不動產保險公司。透過我們的子公司 ServiceLink Holdings, LLC ("ServiceLink")，我們提供房貸交易服務，包括不動產相關服務及房貸貸款之生產與管理。我們同時也是透過我們擁有控制權之子公司 F&G Annuities & Life, Inc. ("F&G")，為零售年金與壽險客戶及機構客戶提供保險解決方案之領導供應商。

我們於 2022 年 12 月 1 日完成先前公告之分拆與發放，以比例方式發放給股東，約 15% 之 F&G 普通股 ("F&G Distribution")。完成 F&G Distribution 後，我們透過約 85% 之持股，繼續控制 F&G。F&G Distribution 係透過發放 68 份 F&G 普通股 (每股面值 $0.001)，對應我們每 1,000 份普通股 (每股面值 $0.0001)，作為於 2022 年 11 月 22 日營業日結束時持有我們普通股之股東之股息。我們於 2025 年 12 月 31 日完成先前公告之發放，以比例方式發放給股東，約 12% 之 F&G 普通股 ("2025 F&G Distribution")。因 2025 F&G Distribution，我們持有 F&G 普通股約 70%。

因 F&G Distribution，F&G 成為一間獨立、公開上市之公司，其業務、資產與負債為其作為提供保險解決方案服務零售年金與壽險客戶及機構客戶之業務相關。透過 F&G 之保險子公司，包括 Fidelity & Guaranty Life Insurance Company ("FGL Insurance") 及 Fidelity & Guaranty Life Insurance Company of New York ("FGL NY Insurance")，F&G 推廣一項廣泛之年金產品組合，包括固定指數年金 ("FIA")、註冊指數連結年金 ("RILA") (合稱為指數年金)、固定利率年金包括多年度保證年金 ("MYGAs")、即期年金、指數萬用壽險 ("IUL")、資金協議 (透過資金協議背書債券發行 ("FABNs") 及聯邦住宅貸款銀行亞特蘭大分行 ("FHLB")) 及退休金風險轉移解決方案 ("PRTs")。FNF 所有核心不動產保險、不動產、資訊科技及房貸相關業務、資產與負債，除由 F&G 持有者外，皆繼續由 FNF 持有。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們有以下應報告分部：
•不動產保險。此分部包含我們不動產保險經理人及相關業務之運作，提供不動產保險及託管及其他不動產相關服務，包括信託業務、 trustee sales guarantees 及住宅保修產品。此分部亦包含我們之交易服務業務，包含用於房貸貸款之生產與管理之其他不動產相關服務，包括經歷違約之房貸貸款。
•F&G。此分部主要為我們年金與壽險相關業務之運作。此分部透過其零售通路，發行一項廣泛之年金與壽險產品組合，包括延期年金、即期年金及 IUL 保險。此分部亦透過其機構通路提供資金協議及 PRTs。
•母公司及其它。此分部包含母公司控股公司之運作、我們之不動產科技子公司、其他較小且非不動產業務，以及某些未分配之母公司營運費用及與我們不動產保險分部之間收入與費用之抵銷。
我們認為，我們的競爭優勢包括以下內容：
企業原則。我們管理哲學與營運成功的基石，是我們創立時所秉持的六項基本準則，這些準則為：
•自主與創新精神；•行動取向；•以客戶為導向且具動機；•減少官僚主義；
這六項準則自員工進公司第一天起便被強調，並為我們下列所描述的許多策略所內建。

住宅與商業不動產過戶保險領導者。我們是美國最大的過戶保險公司之一，也是美國不動產交易中過戶保險、託管及其他過戶相關服務的主要提供者。根據美國土地過戶協會（"ALTA"）的資料，截至2025年第三季，我們的保險公司佔美國過戶保險市場的32%市佔率。雖然住宅過戶保險佔據我們業務的大多數，但我們也是美國商業不動產過戶保險的重要提供者。我們在商業不動產市場的獨立過戶代理網路與直接營運所設立的辦事處，是業界規模最大的之一。我們的商業網路與財務實力，使我們的過戶保險業務對需要發行較大規模商業過戶保單的大型全國性貸款機構而言，具有吸引力。
與客戶建立的穩固關係。我們與使用我們過戶服務的客戶之間有強大的關係。我們的分銷網路包括約1,300家直接過戶辦事處與約5,100家代理，是美國規模最大的之一。我們也因多個過戶品牌所具有的強大品牌認知度而受益，這使我們能接觸到比單一統合品牌運作更廣的客戶羣，並為客戶提供多樣的品牌選擇。

於 2025 年 6 月 11 日，本公司完成自特拉華州至內華達州之重組（"重組"）。自 2025 年 6 月 11 日起，本公司之業務不再受特拉華州公司法規約束，並採用新之章程及章程規則，受內華達州修正法規約束。重組並未導致本公司之業務、實體營運地點、管理層、資產、負債或淨值有任何變動，亦未導致本公司現有員工，包括管理層之工作地點有任何變動。重組亦未影響本公司與任何第三方之重大契約，且本公司在這些重大契約安排下之權利與義務，在重組後仍為本公司之權利與義務。本公司之日常營運業務將與重組前相同。
本公司之房地產分部營業收入與房地產業務活動之水準密切相關，包括銷售、房貸融資及房貸重新貸款。房地產業務活動水準或房地產銷售平均價格之下降，將不利於本公司之房地產保險收入。
本公司發現住宅房地產業務活動通常取決於以下因素：
•房貸利率；•房貸資金供給；•住宅存貨與房價；•商業房地產之供給與需求；以及
•美國經濟之強弱，包括就業水準。
美國抵押貸款銀行協會（MBA）最新預測，截至 2026 年 2 月 17 日，預估（實際為財務年度 2024 年）美國住宅房貸發放市場規模，如以下表格所示，為 2024 至 2028 年之數據（單位：萬億）：

美國聯邦準備理事會自2022年3月接近零的基準利率調升至2023年7月的5.25%至5.50%之間，以應對通貨膨脹。隨後在2024年通貨膨脹下降，美國聯邦準備理事會將基準利率降至2024年12月31日的4.25%至4.50%之間。美國聯邦準備理事會進一步在2025年將基準利率調降75個基點，至2025年12月31日的3.50%至3.75%之間。30年期固定利率房貸的平均利率分別為2025年12月31日結息年度為6.6%，2024年為6.7%，2023年為6.8%。
供應鏈中可銷售住宅的短缺、住宅價格上漲、房貸利率波動、通貨膨脹、勞動市場受擾及地緣政治不確定性，使2023年、2024年及2025年的住宅不動產市場面臨挑戰。2026年初，聯邦政府實施或提出改革措施以應對住宅及住宅負擔能力問題，包括指示某些政府支持企業購買最高達2000億美元的房貸-backed證券，以期降低利率、提高負擔能力並縮小房貸利率與國庫券收益率之間的差距。
2025年12月現有住宅銷售量較2024年同期成長1%，而現有住宅銷售中位數價格則升至405,400美元，較2024年同期成長0.4%。2024年12月現有住宅銷售量較2023年同期下降9%，而現有住宅銷售中位數價格則升至404,400美元，較2023年同期成長6%。
根據美國勞工部勞動統計局的資料，2023年全年失業率接近歷史低點。2025年12月失業率為4.4%，2024年12月為4.1%，2023年12月為3.7%。

headings: 風險因素與市場狀況相關
若經濟與信用市場條件惡化，可能會對本公司的投資組合產生重大不利影響，也可能導致本公司股票價格大幅波動。
股權市場波動可能對本公司業務產生負面影響。
總體經濟狀況可能對本公司業務、營運成果與財務狀況產生不利影響。
本公司的投資面臨市場與信用風險。這些風險在金融與信用市場出現極端波動或中斷期間可能會更加嚴重。
若實體經濟活動水平出現不利變化，本公司的收入可能會下降。
利率波動可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、流動性、營運成果與現金流產生不利影響。
F&G 因其他風險而面臨流動性風險。
風險因素與我們的業務相關
我們因過去的併購而計提商譽，若經濟衰退，這些賬項可能發生減損，導致需要提列減損費用，進而降低我們的營運收入。
若我們的實際經驗與預估的備抵 assumptions 有顯著差異，我們可能面臨損失。
我們為控股公司，並依賴子公司的現金分紅以取得現金。
若我們在委外合作關係中遭遇困難，可能導致業務中斷或受損。
若我們無法吸引並留住全國性行銷機構及獨立經銷商，我們的產品銷售可能減少。
企業整體風險管理流程失敗，可能導致意外財務損失、聲譽受損、額外成本或影響我們有效經營業務的能力。
本公司與大型房貸貸款人、貸款服務機構或政府 sponsored 企業的關係變化，可能對我們的房貸保險及貸款服務子公司造成不利影響。
若信用評等機構降低我公司保險公司的評等，將可能使本公司營運成果與財務狀況受影響。
若我公司聲請損失防範程序失敗，將可能導致產生重大聲請損失。
我公司對於大量不動產保險保單使用獨立經紀人，可能不利於不動產聲請案件的發生頻率與嚴重程度。
我公司營運面臨風險，係因本公司採用自有通路策略並投資於通路整合。
與本公司在 F&G 持有過半股權相關之風險因素
F&G 通路可能不利於本公司營運成果或財務狀況。
部分 F&G 董事可能因持有 FNF 智慧財產權或曾任或現任 FNF 職務，而產生實際或潛在之利益衝突。
與本公司營運地區集中於各業務分部相關之風險因素
本公司 F&G 業務在某些州銷售人壽保險與年金產品，可能使我們面臨因該州總體經濟衰退或災難而產生的損失。
與保險產業政府監管相關的風險因素
我們對標題保險所收取的費用進行州級監管，可能不利於我們的營運結果。
本公司 F&G 業務受到高度監管，並須遵守眾多法律限制與規範。
F&G 的業務在各經營司法管轄區均受政府監管，監管機構對我們的業務與業務作法擁有廣泛的行政與裁量權。
paragraphs: 除一般商業風險外，我們面臨重大風險與不確定性，包括下列所列及本年度報告其他處所描述的風險。任何上述所列風險均可能導致對我們營業收入或財務狀況造成重大或具體的不利影響。

我們的投資組合面臨經濟與金融市場風險，包括利率變動、信用市場及可交易權證與固定收益證券價格的變化。我們在人壽保險業務中的投資政策旨在透過投資收入與資本增值來實現總回報，同時符合對本金的中度風險，並提供足夠流動性，並符合內部與監管指引。為達成此目標，我們的可交易債務投資主要為投資等級、流動性高、固定收益證券與以美元計價的貨幣市場工具。我們會投資某些權證與優先股，以利用所認為的價值並達成戰略目的。經濟與信用市場條件可能不利於某些投資證券發行人的償還義務能力，並影響投資證券的價值。若我們投資的帳面價值高於公允價值，且公允價值的下降被認為是非暫時性的，我們將必須減記投資價值，這可能會對我們的營業收入與財務狀況造成重大負面影響。

固定到期日證券、權證與衍生工具代表我們資產負債表中以公允價值計入的總現金與投資資產的大多數。公允價值定義為在測量日（即退出價格）於市場參與者之間進行有序交易中，出售資產或轉讓負債所收到的價格或支付的金額。公允價值的估計是根據可得的市場資訊與特定時間點對金融工具的判斷進行的。我們對投資將持續依照契約條款表現的預期，是根據我們正常的信用監控程序所收集的證據，以及市場參與者在決定當前公允價值時所使用的假設進行的。
某些我們資產的價值與表現取決於這些投資背後擔保品的表現。這些擔保品可能無法達到預期表現，導致我們持有這些類型證券的現金流出現不利變化。

此外，許多與我們業務無關的因素可能導致我們普通股的市場價格上漲或下跌，包括其他可比公司的營運與股票價格表現、投資者對我們產業的一般看法，以及總體經濟與市場條件的變化。若我們產業的股票市場或股票市場整體失去投資者信心，我們普通股的交易價格可能因與我們業務、財務狀況或營運結果無關的原因而下跌。若上述任何情況發生，可能會導致我們股票價格下跌，並使我們面臨訴訟，即使成功辯護，也可能導致高昂的辯護成本，並分散管理層的注意力。
與我們年金產品相關的GMWB附約的預估成本 incorporates 各種關於特定時間段內權益市場整體表現的假設。權益市場出現顯著且持續的下跌或增加的權益波動，可能會導致與這些產品相關的市場風險利益（"MRB"）或契約持有人資金賬戶負債的價值增加，進而導致我們的收入與淨收入減少。
